source: Owner-accepted generative completion WG_KIKO_REFERENCE_COMPLETED_GEN_20261107.png (2026-11-07). cut_method: v3 outline cuts (unchanged boundaries/pivots) + v4 cleanup pass: connected-component floater audit on every part - detached splash/drips/flecks removed, ground/side splash cut to the shoes' drawn lower outlines, tights-pattern components mis-claimed by the torso returned to the thighs, and the right shoe's clipped toe restored from the source (see README floater audit). Pivots, poses, stacking and timing are byte-for-byte the v2/v3 specs.
